design: Thin slightly hunched middle-aged archivist with an elongated swept skull, close-set four mandibles and tightly braided dreadlocks gathering behind the right shoulder. Parchment-colored crosswrap over a black long robe, several small angled record sleeves on belt, loose short sleeves. Left palm holds a small open archival box of rigid memory slats; right hand selects one slat carefully. Weathered beige-grey hide.
